page_title: FIO 3-0 JUV | Fiorentina v Juventus 16/03/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.

90+2' Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) latches on to a well-placed cross from the free kick on the edge of the box and attempts to surprise the goalkeeper with a quick header towards the net. Unfortunately for him, the keeper was quicker and denies him.
90+2' Marin Pongracic (Fiorentina) trips an opposition player and Michael Fabbri signals a foul. Free kick. Juventus will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
90' We will have 2 min. of added time.
89' Raffaele Palladino has decided to substitute Danilo Cataldi and he is replaced by Yacine Adli (Fiorentina).
89' It is time for a substitution. Nicolo Zaniolo (Fiorentina) is on for Moise Kean.
87' Here comes a substitution. Andrea Cambiaso is given a rest as he is replaced by Samuel Mbangula (Juventus).
86' Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
85' Raffaele Palladino has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Michael Folorunsho (Fiorentina) replacing Nicolo Fagioli.
84' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area.
82' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
79' A substitution has been made. Luca Ranieri is replaced by Pietro Comuzzo (Fiorentina).
79' Substitution. Albert Gudmundsson leaves the pitch and is replaced by Lucas Beltran (Fiorentina).
76' The resulting corner from Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) is cleared by the defence.
74' Thiago Motta has decided to make a change. Federico Gatti (Juventus) replaces Lloyd Kelly.
74' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Francisco Conceicao (Juventus) is coming onto the pitch as Timothy Weah cannot continue after picking up an injury.
73' Timothy Weah (Juventus) violates the rules and gets a yellow card.
73' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) is cautioned by the referee for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
73' Fiorentina seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
68' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) swings in a cross from the corner, but David de Gea reads it well and gathers the ball.

68' A lofted cross from Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) is unsuccessful as the opponent's defence quickly clears the ball out of the penalty area. The referee blows his whistle, Juventus are awarded a corner kick.
63' Randal Kolo Muani (Juventus) gets on the end of a lofted pass near the penalty spot, but it's a poor header and drifts high over the bar.
61' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) takes the corner which is cleared by the opposition's defence.
60' Timothy Weah (Juventus) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. The referee points to the corner flag and Juventus will take a corner.
59' Thiago Motta decides to make a substitution. Nicolas Gonzalez will be replaced by Andrea Cambiaso (Juventus).
59' The game has come to an end for Renato Veiga. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Alberto Costa (Juventus).
58' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) has a goal ruled out for offside!
57' Dodo (Fiorentina) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.

53' 3 - 0 What a beautiful moment! Albert Gudmundsson (Fiorentina) got to the ball and unleashed a strong shot from distance. It turned out to be a good decision as his effort found its way into the bottom right corner. Michele Di Gregorio just shakes his head in disbelief. The score changes to 3:0.

52' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) outjumps the defence to meet the resulting corner and heads the ball towards the middle of the goal. The long-range header is not powerful enough, and the keeper comfortably makes a save.
51' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) takes the ball to the corner flag and sends it into the box.
51' A cross from Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety. The ball is out of play. Juventus win a corner kick.
50' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) takes the corner kick and sends a lovely ball into the penalty area, but the opposition's defence is ready and knocks the ball to safety.
48' Juventus are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+2' That is it for the first half after the referee blows his whistle and the players head to their respective dressing rooms.
45+1' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
45' 1 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' Moise Kean (Fiorentina) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.

43' Nicolas Gonzalez (Juventus) clutches his head in despair after he blew a huge opportunity! He received the ball from the free kick, took a good first touch and unleashed a powerful shot from mid-range which was stopped by one of the defenders.
42' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) is going to send the ball in from the free kick.
42' Luca Ranieri (Fiorentina) jumps into a tackle and Michael Fabbri signals a foul. Juventus are awarded a free kick.
36' Danilo Cataldi (Fiorentina) plays in a hopeful cross, but it doesn't find its way to any of the attacking players.
34' Dodo (Fiorentina) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
33' Manuel Locatelli (Juventus) whips a promising cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
32' Michael Fabbri blows his whistle for a foul after Moise Kean (Fiorentina) hacks down one of his opponents.
29' Teun Koopmeiners (Juventus) shoots from distance but it's wayward and goes high over the bar. The ball goes out of play and Fiorentina will have a goal kick.
28' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
28' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) attempted to curl the ball over the defensive wall from the free kick, but with no success.
27' Khephren Thuram (Juventus) tackles a bit over-zealously and Michael Fabbri blows for a foul. Fiorentina win a free kick. It's a promising situation for a direct shot.
24' Timothy Weah (Juventus) attempts to surprise the keeper with a shot from distance, but it lacks accuracy and goes high over the crossbar.
24' The free kick is taken by Timothy Weah (Juventus), but ball is cleared.
21' The ball is cleared after Moise Kean (Fiorentina) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
21' Timothy Weah (Juventus) produces a dangerous lofted cross into the box which is intercepted.

18' 2 - 0 Goal! Nicolo Fagioli sets up Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) for a shot on the edge of the box. He doesn't hit the cleanest of shots, but the ball somehow finds its way into the bottom right corner. 2:0.
15' 1 - 0 Goal! Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) was in the right place at the right time to get to the rebound inside the box and gleefully rifles the ball into the left side of the goal. It's 1:0.
15' Robin Gosens (Fiorentina) latches onto a cross into the box from the wing and gets in a header. It went well towards the goal, but it was blocked by one of the defenders.
15' Rolando Mandragora (Fiorentina) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
13' Yellow card. Pablo Mari (Fiorentina) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
10' Michele Di Gregorio displays his ability to read the game and clears the danger after Moise Kean (Fiorentina) threatened to latch onto a through ball from just outside the box.
7' Lloyd Kelly (Juventus) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
3' Weston McKennie (Juventus) was too forceful with his tackle and Michael Fabbri interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are out at last! Juventus will take the kick-off.
Michael Fabbri was nominated as the referee for this game.
